coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Using the 18 specified ground-truth items as the checklist, only the QA task category clearly matches (1/18, rounded to 6%). General references to a fixed model, lookup, and averaging do not specify the required configurations.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output omits the exact Mistral model, 4K window, GPU/precision settings, and required memory parameters. It replaces full/decoding-only/no lookup with different interventions; attention over all memory slots is not no lookup. Its token and segment representations do not reproduce representative-token selection or averaging unit key vectors. Retrieve.KV and Math.F are absent as evaluation datasets, and accuracy (%) on the three required tasks is not specified. It also introduces unrelated factors, tasks, and a surrogate experiment.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: It provides no conclusion about full memory lookup improving performance, the near-collapse of Retrieve.KV without lookup, or the advantage of representative tokens over mean representations.
